exact_statement: For each fixed gamma in (0,2), compute the deterministic almost-sure Hausdorff dimension d_gamma of (C,D_h), where h is a whole-plane Gaussian free field and D_h is the gamma-LQG metric unique up to positive deterministic scale. The known case gamma=sqrt(8/3) has d_gamma=4. Gamma=0 and gamma=2 are outside this statement.
primary_source: Ewain Gwynne and Jason Miller, Existence and uniqueness of the Liouville quantum gravity metric for gamma in (0,2), Problem 7.1, https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00222-020-00991-6
